/reports.description: The Reports resource allows you to generate and retrieve detailed reports on various transactions and financial activities within a specified date range.It supports different types of reports, such as credit card reconciliations, ACH settlements, and more, enabling merchants to efficiently monitor and analyze their payment processing data. The resource provides pagination support, allowing users to navigate through large datasets.Reports can include information such as transaction IDs, dates, amounts, payment methods, settlement statuses, and batch details, helping merchants manage and reconcile their financial records effectively.

post.description: The Custom Report API endpoint allows users to fetch a report based on a specified title and date range. Query parameters page and pageSize enable pagination of the report results for efficient data retrieval.
